title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 11.4 Partial Fractions: Decompose P ( x ) Q ( x ) , where Q ( x ) has only nonrepeated linear factors.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 11.4 Partial Fractions: Decompose P ( x ) Q ( x ) , where Q ( x ) has only nonrepeated linear factors.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "11.4 Partial Fractions", prints these objectives: "Decompose P ( x ) Q ( x ) , where Q ( x ) has only nonrepeated linear factors." "Decompose P ( x ) Q ( x ) , where Q ( x ) has repeated linear factors." "Decompose P ( x ) Q ( x ) , where Q ( x ) has a nonrepeated irreducible quadratic factor." "Decompose P ( x ) Q ( x ) , where Q ( x ) has a repeated irreducible quadratic factor.". The section text says: "Earlier in this chapter, we studied systems of two equations in two variables, systems of three equations in three variables, and nonlinear systems. Here we introduce another way that systems of equations can be utilized—the decomposition of rational expressions." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
